# JP Investor Group LLC

> JP Investor Group LLC is a privately held real estate investment, acquisitions, and development company headquartered in Marlton, New Jersey.

## Company

JP Investor Group LLC evaluates residential, multifamily, land, development, distressed, value-add, redevelopment, portfolio, commercial, and mixed-use real estate opportunities.

The company works with property owners, investors, agents, brokers, wholesalers, developers, builders, lenders, attorneys, title professionals, property managers, and contractors.

## Contact

- Address: 701 Route 70 W, Marlton, NJ 08053, United States
- Email: JPInvestorGroup@yahoo.com
- Property review: Use the “Submit a property” path on the website.
- Development opportunity: Use the “Submit a development opportunity” path on the website.

## Positioning

JP Investor Group LLC approaches transactions with capital, credibility, market knowledge, relationships, communication, and execution in mind. The company does not publish unverifiable transaction counts, reviews, awards, or urgency claims.
